query:
select count(*) as "count!",
                  coalesce(ceil(extract(epoch from (min(created_at) + interval '24 hours' - now()))), 0)::bigint
                    as "frees_in!"
             from free_scans
            where registrable_domain = $1 and status <> 'failed'
              and created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
